mapper.select: /* AiConversationMapper.findConversationsByOwner */ SELECT c.id, c.owner_user_no, c.title, c.mode, c.context_label, c.context_data, c.use_yn, c.created_by, c.updated_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.last_message_at, COUNT(m.id) AS message_count FROM ( SELECT id, owner_user_no, title, mode, context_label, context_data, use_yn, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at FROM ai_conversation WHERE owner_user_no = #{ownerUserNo} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) c LEFT JOIN ai_message m ON m.conversation_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.owner_user_no, c.title, c.mode, c.context_label, c.context_data, c.use_yn, c.created_by, c.updated_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.last_message_at ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.update: /* AiConversationMapper.softDeleteConversation */ UPDATE ai_conversation SET use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND use_yn = 'Y'
